objective: Review only the assigned change against every required security category and return severity, evidence, and an explained attack path without speculative blocking.
verification_requirements: Review all eleven required categories against the exact assigned change and identify relevant trust boundaries.
Give every finding a severity, evidence status, bounded concrete evidence, and a multi-step attack path.
Treat only verified high or critical findings as blocking; supported and speculative findings remain non-blocking.
Do not scan, execute code, use network access, request permissions, expose secrets, or write memory from this unbound template.
